hero_description.en: The Media Technology Monitor (MTM) delivers more than 70 executive-level reports and infographics each year, covering the trends, platforms, behaviours, and audiences shaping Canadian media and technology. Available in both official languages, our research helps organizations quickly understand what’s changing — and what matters next.

featured_report_description.en: Learn about how YouTube became the primary viewing destination for Canadian youth, with key details across different language markets, age groups, regions, viewership of other content and more.

section_2_title.en: Research Across Every Corner of Canadian Media Behaviour

section_2_description.en: From streaming and social platforms to news consumption, gaming, AI, and connected devices, MTM reports uncover how Canadians engage with media and technology across generations and demographic groups.

report_card_title.en: Kids and their Reliance on the media and their portable devices

report_card_description.en: This report looks at the demographics of children that access news and the most used sources for news content.

section_3_description.en: MTM reporting helps organizations better understand the behaviours, attitudes, and technology adoption patterns of Canadians across distinct demographic and cultural segments.

free_report_1_description.en: Explore the latest shifts in platform adoption, connected devices, subscription services, and digital behaviours among Canadian adults.

free_report_2_description.en: Understand how younger audiences are shaping the future of media through evolving viewing habits, gaming behaviours, and digital engagement.

free_report_3_description.en: Gain insight into the media preferences, platform usage, and technology adoption patterns of Canadians who have arrived within the past five years.

section_4_description.en: MTM infographics translate complex research into concise, visual storytelling designed for presentations, strategy sessions, and quick decision-making.

infographic_title.en: Who is coming out ahead in the streaming wars?

infographic_description.en: Learn how paid streaming services stack up against each other and other types of media.

section_5_description.en: Description about what this section is

news_card_description.en: New MTM findings reveal growing engagement with digital media among Canadian children, including rising usage of streaming, social video, and mobile-first content platforms.
